बालकः पुस्तकं पठति।.sense_note: Action. Letters become a living line.

नदी वेगेन वहति।.sense_note: Water moving. Same नदी as the Map shelf.

गजः मन्दं चलति।.sense_note: The animal by how it moves. Same गजः as Nature.

सूर्यः आकाशे उदयति।.english_meaning: The sun rises in the sky.
सूर्यः आकाशे उदयति।.sense_note: Morning light. A thing you can point at.

वृक्षः भूमौ तिष्ठति।.english_meaning: The tree stands on the ground.
वृक्षः भूमौ तिष्ठति।.sense_note: A living thing rooted in the ground. Same वृक्षः as Nature.
